lines.text: Does preferring videos mean you only learn visually?
That idea is the learning styles myth.
Researchers surveyed teachers in the UK and the Netherlands.
In the UK, ninety-three percent believed students learn better in their preferred style.
But reviews of the research found little evidence that matching lessons to a style helps.
Match the method to the material, not to a label.

post.title: The Learning Styles Myth Most Teachers Believe #shorts
post.description: Being a 'visual learner' is mostly a myth. Dekker et al. (2012) found 93% of UK teachers believed students learn better in their preferred learning style, but a major review (Pashler et al., 2008) found little evidence that matching teaching to a style improves learning. #psychology #studytips #learning
